blurb.roadmap: Eight weeks, sequenced so each block builds on the last.
blurb.mock: Timed rounds with a question draw and a notes pad.
blurb.cards: Spaced drill over the whole question bank.
blurb.dsa: 256 curated problems across 27 patterns, grouped by the pattern that solves them.
blurb.bank: Short-answer questions with the answer you would actually give.
blurb.ml: Bias–variance, regularisation, metrics, trees, SVMs, causal inference, survival analysis and classical NLP — with the figures.
blurb.dl: Backprop, normalisation, optimisers, distributed training, GNNs and self-supervised learning.
blurb.llm: Tokenisation through serving, plus state-space models, long context and preference optimisation: the core of an AI-engineer loop.
blurb.aieng: Architecture, cost, caching, latency, model selection, on-device models, monitoring, security and governance in production.
blurb.ts: Stationarity to foundation models: forecasting, anomalies, production.
blurb.hld: Twenty-seven full AI system designs, from inference and RAG platforms to gateways, answer engines, agents, memory, document AI, ETAs, training platforms, text-to-SQL, voice, image generation, visual search, vector databases and human-feedback labelling, with estimates, diagrams and trade-offs.
blurb.lld: Machine-coding problems with working reference implementations.
blurb.classic: Eighteen “design X” product cases, each a timed sixty-minute walkthrough.
blurb.infra: Queues, stores, caches, schedulers — the primitives the products assume.
blurb.swe: Design principles, testing, APIs, delivery, architecture, security and leadership.
blurb.py: Object model, generators, decorators, the GIL, asyncio, typing, testing and production Python.
blurb.scale: Caching, databases, replication, sharding, consistency, queues, resilience, SLOs, Kubernetes and multi-region.
blurb.net: TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/1.1–3, TLS, proxies, WebSockets, CDNs, sockets, security and debugging.
blurb.mlc: Implement it from scratch in NumPy: regression, trees, backprop, attention, RoPE, BPE, decoding, LoRA, contrastive losses, word2vec, matrix factorisation, ViT and LSTM backprop — every solution tested.
blurb.mm: ViTs, CLIP, VLM architectures, diffusion, speech, voice agents, video, documents, grounding and serving.
blurb.rs: Chain of thought, test-time compute, PPO, GRPO and RLVR, reward hacking, distillation, honest evaluation, end-to-end long-CoT training, failure modes, and RL environments and verifiers.
blurb.gpu: Rooflines, FLOPs and bytes, precision formats, CUDA, Triton, FlashAttention, collectives, FSDP, inference modelling and cost.
blurb.os: Syscalls, scheduling, sync, deadlock, paging, file systems, I/O, IPC, containers and Linux debugging.
blurb.db: Relational model, normalization, SQL, storage engines, indexes, query plans, recovery, concurrency, NoSQL, OLAP, app patterns, migrations and pgvector.
blurb.math: Probability, distributions, statistics and A/B testing, linear algebra, calculus, optimisation and information theory, worked by hand for ML.
blurb.k8s: Containers vs VMs, images and Dockerfiles, networking, supply chain, the control plane, workloads, Services, storage, scheduling, autoscaling, GitOps, debugging and Kubernetes for ML.
blurb.beh: Scoring and rubrics, STAR and the story bank, intro, conflict, failure, ownership, influence, why us, company frameworks and offers.
blurb.evals: Eval-driven development, golden sets, metrics, LLM judges, human labelling, RAG evals, eval statistics, online tests, red-teaming, synthetic data, data curation and evals in CI and production.
blurb.agent: When to build an agent, the agent loop, tool design, MCP, context engineering and caching, memory, planning and control flow, multi-agent systems, sandboxes and computer use, agent security, durable execution, agent evals, cost and routing, production operations, agent-to-agent protocols (A2A), frameworks compared, and browser and computer-use agents in depth.
blurb.recsys: The search and recommendation stack end to end: funnel and latency budget, BM25, collaborative filtering, two-tower retrieval, hybrid search, ranking models, learning to rank, metrics, features and data, biases and counterfactual evaluation, cold start and bandits, re-ranking and business logic, online experiments, and LLMs in search and recommendation.
blurb.auth: AAA and where auth lives, passwords, sessions and CSRF, JWTs, OAuth 2.0 and PKCE, OpenID Connect and SSO, MFA and passkeys, authorisation models and Zanzibar, multi-tenancy and IDOR, service identity and SPIFFE, secrets and KMS, and auth for RAG, agents and MCP.
blurb.cloud: Regions and shared responsibility, IAM evaluation, VPC networking and data-transfer cost, compute and serverless, storage, managed databases, messaging semantics, Terraform, DR and failover, observability and audit, FinOps, security governance, and GPUs and LLM APIs on the cloud.
blurb.torch: Tensors and autograd, the training loop, memory, checkpoints, ML debugging, a GPT with a KV cache, DDP and FSDP2, torch.compile, export and quantisation, and JAX.
blurb.dataeng: Lake, warehouse and lakehouse, CDC, Parquet and Iceberg internals, Spark joins and skew, orchestration and backfills, streaming, SCD2 and point-in-time training data, quality and contracts, cost.
blurb.safety: Risk areas, alignment training, gaming and sycophancy, deception and eval awareness, interpretability, dangerous-capability evals, frontier frameworks, safeguards, oversight and control, governance, and safety interviews.
blurb.product: Answer structure, north-star and guardrail metrics, metric to model objective, diagnosing drops, funnels and retention, experiment design, launch calls, should-this-be-AI economics, AI feature design and measurement, sizing, and five timed cases.
blurb.algo: How to approach a problem, complexity from constraints, then every pattern from prefix sums to segment trees: recognition, templates, traces and traps.
